bio.text: David J. Else of Overton is the Legal Marijuana NOW nominee for Nebraska's 3rd Congressional District in 2026.
According to the Nebraska Examiner voter guide, he was a dairy farmer for 22 years and a grain farmer and rancher with a cow/calf operation.
Nebraska Public Media reports he has lived and farmed in Overton his entire life and ran for the 3rd District seat in 2022 and 2024.
